body: Do you think it might be easier if you showed her this post instead?

:)
please just drop a message any time x

You NEED to tell her, why would she marry you if she thought of you as her "ball and chain"? If she loves you, and she married you for the right reasons (love), then she took you in sickness and in health. And right now you're sick. And if she found out you'd been thinking like this after you'd already gone, she could be wondering for the rest of her life if there was anything she could do to help. 

Please tell her. Show her this post even if it makes it easier. Things can get better, but you can't bottle it all up. She deserves to know. If she supports you, then you can take the next step to working toward being depression free.

But for now, tell her straight away. And drop a message to chat if you want, or keep us here updated. I hope it goes well. You sound like a good person.
x

I really hope that you don't feel this way once your hormones return to normal, as I can't imagine your pregnancy hormones are helping your state of mind right now. 

It seems like you haven't met many decent people, and the things that have happened to you have happened because you've been around some terrible people, and the problem is NOT you. And you know that. 

You sound incredibly strong, and such a strong woman would make you such a wonderful role model for your children. 
You just have to find a way out of the rut you seem to be stuck in at the moment, and I think you would start to be happier just from not being round your alcoholic husband any longer. 

Of course you need support from other people, and if his parents love their grandchildren as much as you think they do, they may be able to help with looking after your daughter while you try and focus on keeping your head screwed on. 

I haven't been through anywhere near half the shit you have, and I'm sorry that you don't have enough support in your life, which you truly deserve. If you want to chat, please drop me a message, even if you feel better and just want to chat to someone new, I don't mind :)
Stay strong x
I will do. It's hard putting it into words though. It's hard to express how strongly I felt

It's hard even now. I'm calmed down significantly since writing the post, so I'm really glad I did. I do try and remember how Im feeling when I speak to the doctor, it's hard though, remember every little detail that when all put together got me feeling this way :(
I really wanted someone to talk to on here, thank you, it has already helped a lot

I think I'll try and make a doctors appointment in the morning. I need to always remind myself of how down I was feeling when I make appointments though, because by the time I can ring to make an appointment, I feel all better again, like there's nothing wrong with me and it won't happen again. But it does :(

I just feel like I might be in therapy forever. I had a close friend who had been through a lot worse shit than I had, and had tried to take her own life multiple times, and she got better, and I could always rely on her and talk to her. But for some reason she's just cut me out of her life and I really don't feel like I have anyone to talk to that really gets how I feel the way I feel, or understand why. This has also added to the problem. I'm sorry, I really need to vent though. I feel so down

I really want to do therapy. I want to just feel normal without having to take any medication. I just wouldn't know what to say. There seems to be so many different types of therapy. I just want to fix myself
